messages.description: At most one handoff at each priority, containing the independently useful results selected for it. Empty means no delivery. Selected work carries its original preparation, action and sources.

items.description: Copy the supplied item:N labels for all selected results at this priority. Keep distinct situations clear in the handoff.

handoff.description: Write a clear Markdown brief explaining shared context and what matters for delivery. Use headings, prose and lists rather than serialized objects, arrays or raw tool responses. Put each item's work and exact references in prepared_results so they survive independently.

prepared_results.description: For each selected result, use its item:N label as the key and write its value as a Markdown brief. Preserve that item's finished work, useful partial work or Build at delivery brief, its current state and any input still needed. Include exact artifact and card IDs, widget tokens, media or file paths, remaining decisions or checks, and delivery instructions. Save original machine-readable data in this run's directory under workspace/proactivity and reference its exact path. Do not point delivery at temporary source snapshots or paste serialized objects, arrays or raw tool responses into the brief. Cite sources and dates for new findings. Each entry must stand on its own if another item is removed. Never call partial work finished.

priority.description: Omit for regular. High needs a concrete consequence of waiting beyond today.

overrides.description: Usually omit. By selected item:N label, specify only a changed kind or action, additional evidence, or a recovered source message ID. Explain the change in the handoff.

kind.description: Omit to infer from the original Letter or final action. Use follow_up for grounded follow-through on something the user left open.

action.description: The exact action to propose after the remaining choice or permission is resolved. Omit to inherit the prepared action.

evidence.description: Additional source:N labels or original URLs, file paths or record identifiers you read. Original evidence is already included. Explain what these support in the handoff.

reply_to_message_id.description: An exact user message_id from Muse chat history that makes this item's context clear. Omit to preserve the researcher's reference. Recover missing IDs with history search and read the surrounding conversation. This is context for delivery, not a new request or permission.

drop.description: Optional item:N labels to discard because the work is unsupported, unwanted or already handled.

revisit.description: Optional item:N labels mapped to useful future reconsideration times. Omitted work stays pending until expiry; null keeps the ordinary schedule.
